title: Inflation Calculator
summary: This is a utility tool page from the Bank of Canada that allows users to calculate the effect of inflation on dollar amounts using historical CPI data from 1914 to present. It is not a research document, policy statement, or economic commentary.
key_points: Tool uses monthly CPI data from Statistics Canada (V41690973 series) spanning 1914 to present
Basket of goods includes: food, shelter, furniture, clothing, transportation, recreation
Data is typically about two months prior to current month
Links to related investment calculator for savings/investment analysis
